Examples
Examples for divERGe

Examples are found in the examples/ directory. In the git repository, they are furthermore grouped into programming languages. In the release tarball, all examples are merged within examples/.

For a step-by-step tutorial of the python interface, look at examples/?-*.py, i.e., the files

0-init.py
1-model-nickelate.py
2-plot.py
3-interactions.py
4-flow.py

For a step-by-step tutorial of the C/C++ interface, see the documentation of the C library or examples/hubbard.c
